title: STNFS at theta=457/1000 with exact count factors, a lowered metered descent cap and block-Wiedemann 26x5: 2^122.270

claims.statement: For the full production bls12-381-fixed-g1-invert-g2 challenge, the STNFS algorithm of proof.md returns Q in G2 with e(P,Q)=z for the supplied nonidentity P with success at least 0.39 (modelled 0.3962, proof.md section 7) under heuristics H1-H5 (proof.md section 9). The relation-collection region is retuned from theta=23/50 to theta=457/1000 on the same A^2=2^21 lattice (a uniform sub-region of the certified sampled pool), with exact certified lattice-count products at radius 978 of 0.974305697 (yield) and 1.024817778 (work), leaving the relation margin at 0.3035 bits (above the model's 0.30 floor). The sampled relation-collection work carries an 11.64% canonical-work allowance equal to 4.50 incidence-inclusive standard errors (2.585%) of the total-work estimator over the 1824 contributing draws of the 20000-draw pool, computed in the experiment; this covers both the conditional row-mean and the incidence variance terms identified in exploratory review. Block-Wiedemann block sizes are m=26, n=5 (linear algebra 2^119.5568). The two-log descent meter is 2^119.42, above the 2^118.634 expected two-log work; the success bound charges Markov P(cap reached) <= 2^-0.786. A global meter bounds all classical work by W <= 2^122.270 dense-Fp12-multiplication units at C=20,000 instructions; the ledger (proof.md section 8) totals 2^122.269684. No operation is dropped. Preprocessing per instance is at most 2^122.270 units and is included in the total; no external advice is assumed. Storage is at most 2^105 bytes. Nothing is amortized across challenges. Analytic exploratory claim, not a full-size run.

experiments.purpose: Recomputes the certificates, rho, pool and its theta=457/1000 uniform sub-region, exact certified lattice-count products at radius 978, the incidence-inclusive total-work standard error and the charged 4.50-SE allowance, the ledger, filtering, the block-Wiedemann parameters, the descent plan with retention model and ECM schedules, toys and audit; prints total_log2W_full_ledger, work_se_total, modelled_success and within_claim.
